summary_en: Nagoya Railroad authorized acquisition of up to 6.0 million shares (3.06% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for up to ¥10.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with all acquired shares to be canceled.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 11, 2026, Nagoya Railroad's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 6.0 million shares of its own common stock, representing 3.06% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock held as of September 30, 2026: 196,246,811 shares), for a maximum aggregate amount of ¥10.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from November 12, 2026 to March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the purpose of this buyback is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. Following acquisition, all treasury shares obtained through this program will be canceled pursuant to a separate board resolution under the Companies Act.
